2019-20 UCSC General Catalog / Courses / HAVC - History of Art and Visual Culture / Upper-Division / HAVC143E

History of Art and Visual Culture
HAVC143E History of Design: The Objects of Technology, 1850-The Present

	Traces the connections between key movements in modern design and the 
evolution of technology in society. Also provides a framework for 
engaging critically with the proliferation of technology in society 
today.


		Credits
	5


		General Education Code
	PE-T


		Instructor
	Albert Narath
